messages.content:
The failure occurs in the `testLongLineChunkingIndentIgnored` test method of `org.apache.commons.cli.bug.BugCLI162Test`. The test sets up an `Options` object with a long description, then creates a `HelpFormatter` and attempts to print help with the long description. 

The bug report states that there is an infinite loop in the wrapping code of `HelpFormatter`. This issue occurs when there is not enough space to display a word on a single line, causing `HelpFormatter` to go into an infinite loop until the JVM crashes with an OutOfMemoryError.

To diagnose this issue, we can examine the `printHelp` method in the `HelpFormatter` class. The `printHelp` method is overloaded, but the key functionality is in the method with the signature:
```java
public void printHelp(PrintWriter pw, int width, String cmdLineSyntax, String header, Options options, int leftPad, int descPad, String footer, boolean autoUsage)
```

The `printHelp` method first checks if `cmdLineSyntax` is provided and then calls `printUsage` based on the `autoUsage` flag. It then prints the `header`, `options`, and `footer` if they are provided.

The issue may lie in the handling of the long description in the `printWrapped` method or the word wrapping logic within the `printHelp` method itself, which could cause the infinite loop when processing a long description.

To further investigate and fix the issue, the following methods can be modified:
- `org.apache.commons.cli.HelpFormatter.printWrapped(java.io.PrintWriter, int, java.lang.String)`
- `org.apache.commons.cli.HelpFormatter.printHelp(java.io.PrintWriter, int, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, org.apache.commons.cli.Options, int, int, java.lang.String, boolean)`

These methods are likely to be involved in the word wrapping and formatting of the help text, which could be causing the infinite loop and OutOfMemoryError.

Based on the available information, provide the signatures of the most likely culprit methods for the bug. Your answer will be processed automatically, so make sure to only answer with the accurate signatures of all likely culprits (in `ClassName.MethodName(ArgType1, ArgType2, ...)` format), without commentary (one per line).

```
org.apache.commons.cli.HelpFormatter.printWrapped(java.io.PrintWriter, int, java.lang.String)
org.apache.commons.cli.HelpFormatter.printHelp(java.io.PrintWriter, int, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, org.apache.commons.cli.Options, int, int, java.lang.String, boolean)
```
